_readme: Known findings of the nightly production crawl (scripts/seo-prod-crawl.mts), one per entry, each with a one-line reason.
The crawl fails only on findings NOT listed here. An entry whose page was graded and no longer shows the finding is printed as "fixed, remove from baseline".
RULE: entries may only be REMOVED. Never add one without the owner's OK, and never to make a red run green.
Key: rule|where|detail, exactly as the crawler prints it under each new finding.
Seeded on 2026-10-15 from a 30-URL sample (--limit 30 --discover 15, 14 legacy URLs, www host), so the first complete nightly will also report findings on URLs outside that sample.
